toy.definition:
n. a nonfunctional replica of something else (frequently used as a modifier)
n. a device regarded as providing amusement
v. manipulate manually or in one's mind or imagination
toy.translation:
n. 玩具, 小玩艺儿, 小型的东西, 消遣
a. 供玩耍的, 作为玩具的
vi. 玩弄, 戏弄, 调情

toy boy.translation: n. 小白脸一般形容长得俊俏的男子（口语）

toy computer.translation: [计] 游戏计算机, 玩具计算机

toy industry.translation: [网络] 玩具业；中外玩具制造

toy manchester terrier.translation: [网络] 曼彻斯特玩具梗；玩具曼彻斯特梗；玩具曼彻斯特梗犬

toy with.translation: 玩弄, 不很认真地考虑

toy with an idea.translation: 不太认真地考虑,半假半真地考虑

toy-boy.translation: n. （指由年长很多的女子供养的情夫）英俊少年, 男妓

toyboys.translation: (toyboy 的复数) n. （年纪比女友小得多的）小情郎, 小情夫

toye.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 托伊 Toy的变体

toyer.definition: n. One who toys; one who is full of trifling tricks; a trifler.

toyes.translation: (toye 的复数)  [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 托伊 Toy的变体

toyi-toyi.translation: 托弋托弋舞（或游行）（作为抗议示威, 左右交替抬腿）

toying.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Toy
toying.translation:
n. 玩具；小装饰品；不值钱的东西
vi. 玩弄；调情；随随便便地对待
a. 作为玩具的；玩物似的
n. (Toy)人名；(英、土)托伊；(法)图瓦

toyish.definition:
a. Sportive; trifling; wanton.
a. Resembling a toy.
toyish.translation: a. 玩具般的；小的; 无实际价值的；无意义的；无足轻重的

toyland.translation: n. (虚构的富于传奇冒险色彩的)玩偶世界,小人国

toyman.definition: n. One who deals in toys.

toynbee.definition: n. English historian who studied the rise and fall of civilizations looking for cyclical patterns (1889-1975)

toynbee's corpuscles.translation: [医] 托因比氏小体, 角膜小体

toynbee's experiment.translation: [医] 脱因比氏实验(咽鼓管)

toynbeean.translation: a. (英国历史学家)汤因比的,汤因比风格的,汤因比历史观的

toyota.definition: n. an industrial city of Japan in southern Honshu

toys.definition:
n an artifact designed to be played with
n a nonfunctional replica of something else (frequently used as a modifier)
n a device regarded as providing amusement
n a copy that reproduces a person or thing in greatly reduced size
n any of several breeds of very small dogs kept purely as pets
v behave carelessly or indifferently
v manipulate manually or in one's mind or imagination
v engage in an activity as if it were a game rather than take it seriously

toyshop.definition: n. shop where toys are sold

toyshops.definition:
plural of toyshop
n. shop where toys are sold
toyshops.translation: (toyshop 的复数) n. 玩具店

toytown.translation: a. 幼稚愚蠢的；毫无价值的
